chapter_meta_description: Han Li’s Divine Evil-Repelling Lightning destroys the three-headed tiger demon in an instant. With the battle over, the mysterious black-robed figure removes her hood, revealing a stunning face. But why does Han Li stare so intently?
og_title: The Perfect Counter: Han Li’s Evil-Repelling Lightning Devours a Sky-Tiger
og_description: The white light fades. The demon is ash. A beautiful woman is unveiled. But Han Li’s strange smile hints at a secret not yet told.
twitter_title: Han Li Destroys the Three-Headed Tiger & A Lady is Revealed!
twitter_description: One swing. One flash of light. The combined ghost-demon is erased. The mysterious black-robed cultivator shows her true face, leaving Han Li with a cryptic stare.

lore_anchors.definition: The innate lightning property of the Golden Lightning Bamboo (金雷竹). It is specially effective against demonic, ghostly, and other Yin-aligned entities, making it a perfect counter-weapon against the undead and evil spirits.

A rare and legendary cultivation material, said to be a mutated form of the Thunder Bamboo. A flying sword made from it carries the power to repel all evil, making it a prized treasure for righteous path cultivators.
A rare and powerful type of zombie ghost. Unlike ordinary ghosts, they possess a physical body and can move even in daylight, making them formidable opponents.

In the cultivation world, a last-resort survival technique where a cultivator’s soul forcefully invades and takes over another living body. The tiger demon attempted this by hiding its main souls in the orb.
A core concept in Chinese traditional religion and xianxia. A person (or demon) is composed of multiple soul components. Damage or separation of these parts is often fatal or leads to madness.
A forbidden technique that merges a spirit or demon with another being or object, creating a hybrid entity with enhanced power but often at a terrible cost.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the tiger demon turn to ash so easily when it was supposed to be so strong?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Han Li’s “Divine Evil-Repelling Lightning” is a perfect elemental counter. It is pure Yang energy that specifically negates Yin/demonic/ghostly substances. The tiger demon was a ghost-demon; its very existence was anathema to the lightning.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li destroy the tri-colored orb instead of keeping it?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He recognized it as a trap. The main souls of the three-headed beast were hiding inside it, waiting to possess him the moment he touched it. He destroyed the orb and burned the souls to be safe.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Han Li attracted to the black-robed woman?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Probably not in a simple romantic way. His strange expression suggests he recognizes her or is performing a complex calculation. In the Mortal Stream, a handsome face is often just another variable in a risk assessment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Crying Soul Beast (啼魂兽)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A rare spirit beast with the innate ability to absorb and suppress evil spirits. It is a natural predator of ghosts and demons, making it invaluable in places like the ghost mist.
